desc: Derive and document the characterization: 400 numbers are perfect squares of integers having exactly two distinct prime factors.
Implement the full solution (sieve primes/omegas up to 10^6, collect square bases with omega==2, answer queries via bisect) and verify against sample input/output.
Confirm edge cases (m=1/prime excluded, smallest 400 number 36, integer isqrt avoids float error) and worst-case performance (Q=2*10^5, A=10^12).
